Metadata-protocol: none

The navigation door `created()` has two callers on `main` (`14208f2c`):
- `ResourceEditPage` passes the published body, which carries the page `type`.
- `usePublishAllDrafts` ("Publish all") passes no body, because it holds only the `_drafts` header rows.

To cover both, `useNavigationSync.ts` reads the page by name (`client.meta.getItem('page', name)`) when no body is held.

File surface (added): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx`. Its adapter mock gains `getItem`, and one new case checks that a record page published through "Publish all" writes no app. `usePublishAllDrafts.ts` itself is unchanged.
